title: Writing Task 1: Maps and Spatial Change
verifiableTask: Comparar dois mapas usando posição e mudança

content.text: na Task 1: geralmente dois mapas do
o que mudou, o que foi construído/removido
Ao final da aula você consegue:
comparar dois mapas usando linguagem de posição e verbos de transformação (na passiva).
comparar dois mapas usando posição e mudança.
How has your neighbourhood changed in the last 10 years?
What was built? What was demolished? What stayed the same?
where the old factory used to be
→ a park / was created / in the north of the town → the school / was extended / to the east → the cinema / was demolished / replaced by flats
descreva 3 etapas de um processo na passiva.
was built / was constructed / was erected
was demolished / was knocked down / was removed / was cleared
was converted into / was replaced by / was turned into / was relocated to
was extended / was expanded / was widened / was reduced
trees were cut down · a forest was cleared · farmland was replaced by housing
in the north/south-east of · in the centre · on the outskirts (periferia) · next to · opposite · alongside (ao longo de) · to the west of · across the river · near the coast
Overall, the town became more urbanised / residential / developed, with… · The most significant change was…
The old factory was demolished and replaced by flats, while the park remained unchanged.

questions.questionText: The old factory ______ demolished in 2005. (passiva, passado, singular)

explanations.general: The old factory was demolished in 2005.

options.text: was changed into something with a different use
was destroyed

explanations.general: Correct answer: was changed into something with a different use

questions.questionText: The area on the edge of a town is the ______. (periferia)

options.text: demolished
extended
along the side of the river
under the river

explanations.general: Correct answer: along the side of the river

content.text: The maps illustrate the changes that took place in… between… and…
will be built / is planned to be
1990: farmland north of the river · small school in the centre · forest in the east · one bridge
2020: farmland → housing estate · school extended · forest partly cleared for a car park · second bridge to the west · sports centre next to school
Overall, the village became considerably more developed, with farmland and forest giving way to housing and new facilities.
The most dramatic change took place north of the river, where the farmland
a large housing estate. To link this area to the centre, a second bridge
to the west of the original one…
→ the car park / was converted into / a park → the forest / was cleared to make way for / a road → the library / was relocated to / the town centre → the main road / was widened / to four lanes
Where is the sports centre? Where was the forest? Where is the new bridge?
old hospital → museum · empty land south → new hospital · pedestrian zone in the centre · bike lanes along the river

questions.questionText: The farmland was ______ by a housing estate. (substituída)

explanations.general: The farmland was replaced by a housing estate.

questions.questionText: A second bridge was ______ to the west. (build → particípio)

explanations.general: A second bridge was built to the west.

questions.questionText: For a plan for 2030, which is correct?

options.text: A new hospital was built.
A new hospital will be built.

explanations.general: Correct answer: A new hospital will be built.

options.text: The forest was partly cleared to make way for a car park.
The forest cleared partly for car park.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The forest was partly cleared to make way for a car park.

questions.questionText: The old hospital will be ______ into a museum. (convertido)

explanations.general: The old hospital will be converted into a museum.

questions.questionText: A good overview for the village maps is…

options.text: The village became much more developed, with farmland and forest giving way to housing and facilities.
A second bridge was built to the west in 2020.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The village became much more developed, with farmland and forest giving way to housing and facilities.

content.text: beach along the south · fishing harbour in the west · small car park in the centre · row of fishermen's houses in the east · sand dunes between the beach and the road · road running east–west

beach unchanged · fishing harbour → marina with yachts · car park → public square with cafés · fishermen's houses → hotel · sand dunes partly removed; boardwalk built along the beach · new car park north of the road · road unchanged
introdução + overview + 2 parágrafos (150–180 palavras). Use pelo menos 6 verbos de mudança diferentes e 5 expressões de posição.
confira passiva, preposições de lugar e se mencionou o que
[ ] Overview com a tendência geral (de vila de pesca para área turística)?
[ ] Verbos de mudança variados e na passiva?
[ ] Mencionou o que permaneceu igual (praia, estrada)?
Faça uma lista de 15 verbos de mudança com particípio e uma frase com cada.
Descreva por escrito 5 mudanças no seu bairro (passiva + posição).
(Também é tema comum de Speaking Part 1/3.)
Escreva uma Task 1 de mapas oficial em 20 min.
Escreva 100 palavras sobre um plano imaginário para sua cidade em 2035 (futuro passivo).
Reescreva a tarefa da aula com correções.

questions.questionText: Westbay: what happened to the fishing harbour?

options.text: It was converted into a marina.
It was demolished.

explanations.general: Correct answer: It was converted into a marina.

options.text: a car park
a hotel
the beach and the road
the sand dunes

explanations.general: Correct answer: the beach and the road

questions.questionText: A wooden path along the beach is a ______.
The central car park was ______ into a public square. (transformado — turned)

explanations.general: The central car park was turned into a public square.

options.text: Overall, Westbay changed from a fishing area into a leisure and tourist destination.
Overall, the beach is in the south.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Overall, Westbay changed from a fishing area into a leisure and tourist destination.

content.text: The old hospital will be converted into a museum. A new hospital will be built on the empty land to the south. The centre will be turned into a pedestrian zone. Bike lanes will be created along the river.

Overall, the seafront was transformed from a small fishing area into a leisure destination, with most traditional features replaced by tourist facilities, although the beach and main road remained unchanged.
